title: VCT EMEA 2027 : Fnatic, Gentle Mates, Aurora… Le mercato s’emballe, les premiers rosters se dessinent
content:
Le mercato du VCT EMEA bat son plein. Alors que Riot Games prépare une refonte majeure de son circuit compétitif, les organisations cherchent à construire leurs effectifs pour 2027. Seulement huit structures bénéficieront du statut d’équipe partenaire pour les deux prochaines saisons : Fnatic, Team Heretics, Team Liquid, Karmine Corp, Vitality, Gentle Mates, BBL Esports et FUT Esports. GIANTX et NAVI perdraient ainsi leur place parmi les partenaires, tandis que de nouvelles organisations tenteront de se faire une place grâce aux qualifications ouvertes.

Parmi les projets les plus impressionnants figure celui de Fnatic, qui devrait profondément renouveler son cinq de départ. Seul Kaajak serait conservé parmi les titulaires de 2026, avec les arrivées attendues de marteen et Minny, tous deux issus de Gentle Mates, ainsi que de valyn, ancien capitaine de G2 Esports. Cloud, déjà présent dans l’effectif, compléterait cette nouvelle formation. De son côté, Gentle Mates devrait accueillir Alfajer, en provenance de Fnatic, ainsi que kozzy, MAGNUM et Ruxic. Une reconstruction presque totale pour la structure française, qui s’est séparée de l’ensemble de son précédent effectif après une saison marquée par une qualification aux Masters Santiago.

Mais la grande surprise de cette intersaison pourrait bien venir d’Aurora Gaming. Pour ses débuts sur VALORANT, la structure serbe a officiellement dévoilé un effectif composé de Derke, trexx, Boo, B1SK et Chiwa. Trois joueurs expérimentés du VCT EMEA, accompagnés de deux profils prometteurs, pour un projet particulièrement ambitieux. Bien qu’Aurora ne dispose pas du statut de partenaire, cette équipe pourrait rapidement devenir l’une des principales menaces issues des qualifications ouvertes.

D’autres formations avancent également dans leur recrutement. Team Liquid devrait conserver nAts et kamo, tout en accueillant GSR et Kachoww. Chez Heretics, benjyfishy et RieNs seraient maintenus, accompagnés de chloric, Hiro et Jamelinho213. Du côté des organisations françaises, Mandatory préparerait un joli coup avec l’arrivée de MiniBoo, ancien joueur de Team Heretics et Team Liquid. Joblife a de son côté déjà officialisé les arrivées de hoody et al0rante, tandis que Sevire et WanZeru poursuivront l’aventure. Westside serait également attendu pour compléter l’effectif.

Toutes les équipes n’ont cependant pas encore dévoilé leurs intentions. La Karmine Corp, pourtant sacrée championne du VCT EMEA Stage 2 en 2026, n’a pour l’instant aucune recrue annoncée dans les informations recensées par Sheep Esports . Même constat chez Vitality, finaliste des Champions 2026, qui devra notamment trouver un successeur à Derke. Les deux structures françaises pourraient donc encore réserver plusieurs surprises dans les prochaines semaines.

Enfin, le mercato s’annonce également animé dans le reste de la région. Barça Esports serait en passe d’aligner Fit1nho, MONSTERRR, Palze, Proxh et purp0, tandis que l’Eintracht Francfort préparerait les arrivées d’azury et musashi. Eternal Fire miserait notamment sur echo, Favian et s0pp. Plusieurs organisations restent toutefois dans l’attente de nouvelles annonces, à l’image de BBL Esports et FUT Esports, dont les effectifs ne sont pas encore connus.

title: Netflix Is Making a Live-Action PUBG Series With Donald Glover
content:
Netflix is developing a live-action series based on PUBG: Battlegrounds, and Donald Glover is attached to write, direct, executive produce and star in it. Krafton, which owns the game, and Netflix announced the project on 29 October.

Glover created and starred in Atlanta, which won him two Emmys and two Golden Globes. He is also known for Community and Amazon’s Mr. & Mrs. Smith, and he records music as Childish Gambino. His brother Stephen Glover, a writer on Atlanta, will write and executive produce the PUBG series, Gematsu reported .

The other executive producers are Michael Schaefer for NEON TV, Fam Udeorji for Glover’s company Gilga, and Taeseok Jang and Sujin Lee for LV3H. LV3H is Krafton’s entertainment arm, the new name for what used to be its PUBG Entertainment unit.

The scripts haven’t been written yet, according to What’s on Netflix , which also says LV3H is involved in both development and production. Neither company has shared plot details or any cast beyond Glover, and What’s on Netflix doesn’t expect the show on the service before 2028 at the earliest.

The game gives writers little to adapt. PUBG drops up to 100 players onto an island to scavenge for weapons until one player or squad is left, so the show will need characters and a story of its own.

Krafton has tried to bring PUBG to the screen before. In July 2021 it hired Adi Shankar, the producer of Netflix’s Castlevania, to make a PUBG anime, Hypebeast reported at the time. That project has gone quiet since, and the new announcement doesn’t mention it.

title: LEC : Deft, Diable… NAVI voit très grand pour 2027
content:
Natus Vincere compte bien franchir un cap en 2027. Pour sa première saison complète en LEC, la structure ukrainienne a réussi à s’installer parmi les prétendants aux playoffs, terminant notamment à la quatrième place du Summer Split. Un résultat qui lui a permis de décrocher une invitation à la Demacia Cup Global Invitational, sa première compétition internationale. Mais NAVI ne souhaite pas s’arrêter là. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , l’organisation prépare une profonde reconstruction de son effectif autour d’Enes « Rhilech » Uçan, élu Rookie of the Year en 2026 et sous contrat jusqu’à fin 2027.

Pour accompagner son jeune jungler turc, NAVI aurait déjà exploré plusieurs pistes particulièrement ambitieuses, notamment en Corée du Sud. La structure aurait ainsi tenté d’entamer des discussions avec Kim « Deft » Hyuk-kyu, champion du monde 2022, mais le vétéran avait déjà choisi de rejoindre NS RedForce. Autre nom prestigieux envisagé : Nam « Diable » Dae-geun, l’un des jeunes talents les plus prometteurs de la scène coréenne. Là encore, cette piste ne devrait pas aboutir, le joueur se dirigeant vers une autre destination. Deux tentatives infructueuses qui témoignent néanmoins des ambitions de NAVI sur le marché des transferts.

Et les changements pourraient être nombreux, car Maynter, Poby, SamD et Parus ont tous été autorisés à explorer d’autres opportunités. Les deux premiers sont respectivement sous contrat jusqu’en novembre 2026 et fin 2027, tandis que SamD arrivera également en fin de contrat en novembre et que Parus reste lié à NAVI jusqu’en 2027. Aucun départ n’est encore confirmé, mais la structure étudie des alternatives aux quatre postes, avec la volonté d’entourer Rhilech de joueurs plus expérimentés.

Si le recrutement de stars de LCK ou de LPL reste difficilement envisageable sur le plan financier, NAVI disposerait d’un budget conséquent à l’échelle de la LEC. L’organisation prospecte également en Europe et en Amérique du Nord, où elle pourrait attirer plusieurs profils convoités. Sur le banc, Vasilis « TheRock » Voltis conservera son poste d’entraîneur principal et participera activement à la construction de l’effectif, avec de nouveaux assistants attendus pour renforcer le staff.

Aucune recrue n’a encore été officialisée, mais le message est clair : après avoir posé les bases de son projet en 2026, NAVI veut désormais se donner les moyens de rivaliser avec les meilleures équipes européennes. Et si les pistes Deft et Diable n’ont pas abouti, elles donnent déjà un aperçu de l’ampleur du chantier engagé pour 2027.

title: Overwatch ranks in order (2026): Full rank list and SR explained
content:
Overwatch has 10 competitive ranks starting at Bronze and ending with Top 500 Challenger. Here are all Overwatch ranks in order plus their SR ranges and how the ranked system works in 2026.

The competitive ranks in Overwatch show where you stand on the Competitive Play ladder. Players progress through the Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, Master, Grandmaster, and Champion tiers, and only the best of best are in the Top 500 Challenger rank.

Each Overwatch rank has five divisions going from 5 to 1. Division 5 is the lowest within a rank while Division 1 is the highest. For example, Platinum 5 is the lowest Platinum rank while Platinum 1 is the highest.

Winning Competitive matches increases your rank progress while losing can decrease it. Top 500 Challenger works differently and uses leaderboard placement and Challenger Score instead of the standard division system.

In Overwatch, your rank is determined by your Hero Skill Rating (HSR). This is more commonly known as just “SR” by players.

Winning Competitive matches increases your SR and rank progress while losing can decrease it. Top 500 Challenger uses Challenger Score and leaderboard placement instead of the standard SR divisions.

title: cmtry expected to miss Singapore Major for Astralis after FUT’s Bucharest exit
content:
Nikita “cmtry” Samolotov is expected to miss the PGL Major Singapore 2026 for Astralis after FUT were eliminated from PGL Masters Bucharest in the quarterfinals.

Nemiga’s 2-0 victory over FUT has created a complicated Valve Regional Standings situation that leaves cmtry tied to his former team’s eligible Major roster. Unless FUT play another eligible LAN match before the November 2 invitation cutoff, Astralis will likely have to compete in Singapore without their recently signed rifler.

The issue centers around Valve’s VRS roster rules.

FUT signed Álvaro “SunPayus” García from G2 earlier in October, replacing cmtry in the active lineup.

However, a new player must complete five official matches with a team before being fully reflected in its VRS roster.

FUT’s quarterfinal against Nemiga was only SunPayus’ fourth official match since joining the organization.

title: Aurora Gaming officialise son équipe de stars avec Derke, trexx et Boo
content:
Nouvel acteur sur la scène compétitive de VALORANT, Aurora Gaming affiche déjà de grandes ambitions. Présente sur Counter-Strike 2 et Dota 2, la structure serbe a officiellement dévoilé son premier effectif sur le FPS de Riot Games, composé de Derke, trexx, Boo, B1SK et Chiwa. Un recrutement particulièrement impressionnant pour une organisation qui découvre la discipline, mais qui compte bien rivaliser avec les meilleures formations européennes dès 2027.

La tête d’affiche de cette nouvelle équipe sera évidemment Nikita « Derke » Sirmitev, récemment libéré par Vitality après deux saisons sous ses couleurs. Ancien pilier de Fnatic, avec qui il avait notamment remporté le LOCK//IN São Paulo et les Masters Tokyo en 2023, le Finlandais sort d’une saison conclue par une finale aux Champions 2026, perdue face à LOUD. Il retrouvera chez Aurora son ancien coéquipier Nikita « trexx » Cherednichenko, passé par KOI, Vitality et Team Liquid. Le Russe, qui a participé à trois éditions des Champions, avait notamment contribué au parcours de Liquid jusqu’en finale du VCT EMEA Stage 2 cette année.

Pour diriger ce nouveau cinq, Aurora a également recruté Ričardas « Boo » Lukaševičius, ancien capitaine de Team Heretics. Le Lituanien quitte la structure espagnole après trois saisons marquées par plusieurs performances internationales majeures, dont deux finales en 2024, aux Masters Shanghai et aux Champions. Vainqueur de l’Esports World Cup 2025 et du VCT EMEA Stage 1 en 2026, il apportera son expérience et son leadership dans le rôle d’IGL. B1SK et Chiwa viennent compléter cet effectif, qui mêle joueurs confirmés et profils prometteurs.

Mais malgré ce recrutement XXL, Aurora Gaming devra passer par les qualifications ouvertes pour accéder au VCT EMEA. Contrairement à Fnatic, Vitality ou encore la Karmine Corp, l’organisation ne figure pas parmi les huit équipes partenaires retenues pour le cycle 2027-2028. Elle devra donc gagner sa place sur le serveur pour participer aux premières grandes échéances de la saison, à commencer par le Kickoff. Avec un tel cinq de départ, Aurora s’annonce néanmoins comme l’un des principaux prétendants parmi les équipes non partenaires, capable de rivaliser avec plusieurs formations déjà installées dans l’élite européenne.

title: Vitality shrug off Cache ambush to knock NAVI out of Bucharest
content:
NAVI took the map Vitality almost never lose, but ZywOo on Mirage and ropz on Dust2 turned the series back around.

Team Vitality are in the semi-finals of PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 after a 2-1 win over NAVI on Thursday afternoon. NAVI took their own Cache pick 13-5, Vitality answered 13-9 on Mirage and closed the series 13-6 on Dust2. NAVI go home in fifth to eighth place.

It is Vitality’s third series win over NAVI this month, after a 2-1 at ESL Pro League Season 24 on 4 October and the 2-0 in the Swiss stage on Tuesday . This one started very differently.

Keep chilling @Vitality_apEX TOP 4 SECURED 🫡 pic.twitter.com/49D1PyiwMl

In the Swiss meeting, NAVI had removed Cache. This time they removed Inferno and picked Cache, the map on which Vitality had lost only once since it returned to the pool, an overtime defeat in August. Vitality did not see it coming. “Maybe we thought they were going to go somewhere else, and they picked Cache,” William “mezii” Merriman said in the post-match interview. “I think overall they had a really good plan.”

For four rounds it looked like the usual story. Vitality won all four on the CT side, then lost a couple of rounds without building their economy, and never recovered. NAVI won 13 of the last 14 rounds: 7-1 to reach 7-5 at the break, then all six on Vitality’s T side. The analysts on PGL’s desk pointed to rounds five and 15, the same flash and peek at B: it cost ropz his life when Vitality tried it, and won makazze a double kill when NAVI did.

title: GTA 6 Map Size Could Be As Big As GTA 4, GTA 5 and RDR2 Combined

Residential properties, back alleys, and less populated areas may have hidden details and interesting characters, creating a world that feels more alive than other open-world titles.

The essence of GTA games has often extended beyond the scope of their storylines, which makes the details across the map all the more important for players. Having a more detailed environment would drastically improve the gameplay experience and give players more reasons to spend time exploring and appreciating the efforts of the developers.

With all the details that have surfaced so far, GTA 6 will undoubtedly be the most detailed and graphically intense open-world RPG we have ever seen. With the release a month away, it will be interesting to see how many of these speculations make it into the final game. title: Nemiga’s win over FUT likely costs Astralis cmtry at the Major
content:
Under Valve’s rule for players listed on two Major rosters, Nemiga’s quarter-final win over FUT should keep cmtry on FUT’s list and out of Astralis’ lineup in Singapore, although none of the parties have confirmed it.

FUT Esports went out of PGL Masters Bucharest on Thursday morning, beaten 2-0 by Nemiga in the first quarter-final. The result matters as much in Barcelona as in Bucharest: it means SunPayus stays on four FUT matches, one short of the five that would have taken Mykyta “ cmtry ” Samolotov off FUT’s roster before Valve’s snapshot on 2 November.

FUT’s next match is against Spirit at BLAST Rivals on 11 November, nine days after the snapshot. Unless something changes in the registration, cmtry will still count as a FUT player when the Major invitations go out.

Valve explained the situation earlier this week in a reply that HLTV journalist Striker posted on X, and we went through it on Wednesday . If the same player appears on two invited rosters, the team with the higher VRS keeps him and the other team cannot take part. A player registered on one roster also cannot be registered as a coach or substitute for another.

FUT are above Astralis in the standings. Read together with Thursday’s result, the rule leaves Astralis without cmtry at the Major, not even as a substitute. Their lineup in Singapore should be the one that has played in Barcelona since Wednesday: jabbi , Staehr , phzy , ryu and siuhy , with NEO as coach.

James Banks was among the first to point this out after the quarter-final, writing on X that Astralis will play the Major with jabbi and not cmtry, and that SunPayus will likely play for FUT as a substitute but without a sticker.

title: Valve introduces big head mutators in Counter-Strike 2 alongside silent reload adjustments and leaked LAR rifle files
content:
Valve released a new update for Counter-Strike 2 last night. While the official patch notes focus on adjustments to the silent reload mechanic and minor bug fixes, backend changes discovered by dataminers reveal new casual mode modifiers and files for an unreleased rifle.

The main gameplay modification in the official changelog addresses how players execute silent reloads. Valve added a setting that allows users to switch the silent reload input between hold and toggle. With the toggle option enabled, players can release the reload key once the silent reload animation begins. If a player needs to abort the quiet reload and transition back to a standard fast reload, tapping the reload key a second time will cancel the action.

Alongside the input adjustment, the update resolves an audio defect. Previously, the initial sound cue of a weapon reload would occasionally play for nearby players regardless of whether a silent reload was initiated. This inconsistency has now been patched.

In the miscellaneous section of the patch notes, Valve fixed a rendering issue on AMD graphics cards where liquid surfaces appeared completely black. The developers also corrected multiple user interface and audio bugs triggered when rewinding footage during demo playback.

Beyond the official documentation, inspections of the game files by community dataminers Thour and Gabe Follower exposed new weapon assets. According to Thour, files and an inventory icon for a weapon designated as the LAR were added to the client with this patch.

Gabe Follower noted that this weapon is a renamed version of the previously leaked M14. The current files indicate that the LAR functions like a Winchester rifle, utilizing a per-bullet reloading mechanic. However, the materials for the weapon are currently stored inside a folder labeled “do_not_ship”, indicating that the firearm is still in development and not ready for public release.

title: Worlds 2026 : T1 et Invictus Gaming en quarts, KOI et LYON en 2-2

Les champions du monde en titre n’ont pas tremblé. Opposé à Movistar KOI, T1 a survolé son BO3 pour s’imposer 2-0, porté notamment par un Doran impérial sur la toplane. Le Coréen a terminé la première manche avec un impressionnant 6/0/6 sur Ambessa, avant de récidiver sur Gwen (4/0/7). Une démonstration de force qui permet à T1 de rejoindre Dplus KIA et Gen.G en quarts de finale, devenant ainsi la troisième équipe coréenne qualifiée. Faker continue également d’écrire l’histoire, avec une onzième qualification pour les quarts de finale des Worlds, un record absolu dans la compétition.

Pour KOI, en revanche, la situation devient préoccupante. Après avoir débuté le Swiss Stage par deux victoires, les Espagnols viennent d’enchaîner deux défaites face à Dplus KIA et T1. Désormais en 2-2, ils devront impérativement remporter leur prochain BO3 pour poursuivre l’aventure. Une dernière chance de rejoindre le top 8 mondial, après avoir échoué à faire tomber deux des favoris coréens.

On offre tout à T1 pic.twitter.com/kTYgqGInk5

Dans l’autre rencontre de la soirée, Invictus Gaming a dû batailler pour venir à bout de LYON (2-1). Les Chinois ont d’abord écrasé la première manche en seulement 25 minutes, avec un sévère 19-4 au tableau d’affichage. Rookie s’est particulièrement illustré sur Aurora (8/1/8), pendant qu’Inspired est complètement passé à côté de sa partie avec Nocturne (1/6/1). Le jungler polonais s’est toutefois repris dans la deuxième manche, cette fois sur Qiyana (4/1/5), bien épaulé par un Dhokla agressif sur Olaf (4/2/3). De quoi permettre à LYON d’égaliser et d’arracher une manche décisive.

Mais la manche décisive a rapidement tourné à la démonstration. Dépassé dès la draft, LYON n’a jamais réussi à contenir la botlane chinoise, où JiaQi et Meiko ont fait vivre un véritable enfer à leurs adversaires. Impérial sur Caitlyn (5/1/2), JiaQi a même conclu la rencontre sur un triple kill, scellant la victoire d’Invictus Gaming en seulement 24 minutes. Les Chinois deviennent ainsi les premiers représentants de la LPL à décrocher leur billet pour les quarts de finale de ces Worlds 2026. Une qualification particulière pour TheShy et Rookie, qui se retrouvent ensemble dans le top 8 mondial huit ans après leur sacre historique sous les couleurs d’IG en 2018.

Pour LYON, la désillusion est immense. Après avoir parfaitement lancé leur tournoi avec deux victoires consécutives, les Américains ont enchaîné deux revers face à Gen.G et Invictus Gaming. En 2-2, ils se retrouvent dos au mur comme Movistar KOI. Les deux formations occidentales devront impérativement remporter leur dernier BO3 du Swiss Stage pour espérer rejoindre les quarts de finale.

title: Tencent Pentagon Blacklist: Impact on BGMI and India
content:
Tencent is still on the Pentagon’s list of Chinese military companies, and since June 30 the Tencent Pentagon blacklist has barred it from any contract with the US Department of Defense. On its own, the listing does nothing to BGMI, Valorant or any other Tencent-linked game in India. Washington’s restrictions govern what the US military buys and whom it signs contracts with. Tencent’s connection to Indian players runs through its investments, chiefly its stake in Krafton, the South Korean publisher behind Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI).

Tencent has been on the list for close to two years. It first appeared in a Federal Register notice published on January 7, 2025, and it stayed on the latest version of the list , which the Pentagon released in June this year. For India’s gaming industry, the open question is whether the US designation ever travels to New Delhi, or whether India decides to act against Tencent on its own.

The list comes from Section 1260H of the National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA) for 2021. It requires the Pentagon to name Chinese companies it considers tied to the People’s Liberation Army (PLA) that operate in the US, and to revise the list at least once a year until 2030. The June 2026 notice runs to 188 entities and gives a one-line reason for Tencent: the department says it is indirectly affiliated with the PLA.

Getting to that version was messy. The Pentagon published an update in February 2026, withdrew it from the Federal Register without explanation, and put out a near-identical list in June. Tencent was on the final roster, alongside Alibaba, Baidu, BYD and CATL.

Until this year, a 1260H listing was mostly a reputational problem. That changed on June 30, 2026, when Section 805 of the 2024 NDAA took effect. The Pentagon can no longer sign, renew or extend contracts with listed companies or the businesses they control, and from June 30, 2027 the ban widens to any goods or services that contain something those companies made. A second rule that started the same day bars the Pentagon from hiring contractors whose lobbyists also work for listed firms. Bloomberg reported that Tencent lost four Washington lobbying firms in the weeks after the June update.

Markets took the original listing seriously. Reuters reported that Tencent’s Hong Kong shares fell 7.3% the day after the January 2025 designation, erasing about HK$275 billion in market value. Tencent called its inclusion “a mistake”, said it is neither a military company nor a supplier, and promised to work with the department to clear up the misunderstanding. Close to two years later, it is still listed. Alibaba, added this June, has gone to court to get off.

Justinas “ jL ” Lekavicius could leave professional Counter-Strike after the PGL Major Singapore if no team he wants to join comes in for him. The Lithuanian, who is standing in for Team Vitality at PGL Masters Bucharest 2026, told HLTV after Tuesday’s 2-0 win over NAVI that the Major is his cut-off point.

Ideally I would get a team and I could compete again for trophies, but if that doesn’t work out, it’s not the end of the world. To be honest, if I don’t find a team after Singapore, I might just call it quits. And then just focus on content, focus on wife, focus on my kid because that’s coming on the way.

On PGL’s broadcast the same evening, he had said that he has not signed anything for 2027 and expects most offers to arrive around the Major. The HLTV interview adds what happens if the right one does not. He would rather do other things than end up in a situation he does not want to be in, he said, and what he loves is the process of working towards a trophy with a team, more than the trophies themselves. “If I don’t see it happening, I’m not just going to sign a deal just to play.”

jL joined NAVI in the summer of 2023. Nine months later he was named MVP of PGL Major Copenhagen 2024, the first Major played in CS2, as NAVI lifted the trophy and he became the first Lithuanian to win a Major. He stepped away from the active lineup in July 2025, spent April and May 2026 on loan at MOUZ and left NAVI as a free agent on 1 July 2026.

Since then he has been a stand-in. At BLAST Open Porto he replaced mezii and reached the semi-finals with Vitality, and in Bucharest he fills in for apEX , who is at home for the birth of his child. He does not see the event as an audition. Even a final with this roster would not earn him much credit, he told HLTV: “It’s just Vitality, you know? They could get an academy player and still reach finals.”

title: Save the Children report urges esports to put young players’ wellbeing first
content:
Save the Children has called on the esports industry to put children's rights above competitive goals in a report titled "Protecting Child Rights in Esports," Euronews reported. For the young players who train and compete in structured scenes, the report argues that safeguards haven't kept pace with the expectations placed on them, and that their health, homelife and school life is at risk.

The charity published the report on Tuesday, asking esports to build its practices around the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC). It points out that 300 million children worldwide play, and that, while esports confers advantages, such as teamwork and critical thinking under pressure, children at the moment are at risk of a wide range of issues, including anxiety, online harassment and depression, as well as disrupted sleep, musculoskeletal problems and even sexism. Children who are putting in intensive training may also fall behind at school, and their relationships with their family and friends can suffer.

Theo Toresson, a psychologist and gaming expert at Save the Children, said in a press release that "Esports offers exciting opportunities for children, but participation should never come at the expense of their rights, wellbeing or development." He added that children must be recognized "as children first and competitors second," and called for young people to have a say in decisions that affect them.

Esports can empower young people, but safeguards matter. A new report for Save the Children co-authored by @ThomasHakman @oiioxford explores 9 challenges and 9 opportunities for creating a safer future for youth esports. 📄Read the report: https://t.co/ijdKFoNzLq https://t.co/HZvtlgp3ST

The report's core worry is that children are entering competitive environments that come with the same demands put on pros … but without safeguards built specifically for their age. Poor posture over long sessions can lead to neck, shoulder, and wrist pain, which is why the report points to ergonomic guidance and better-structured practice. And while late-night schedules might be seen by some as a good way of preparing youngsters for the challenging world of pro esports, they can affect rest, mood, and cognitive performance.

One national esports federation representative, quoted anonymously in the report, said there are currently zero established guidelines on playing hours, training methods and dietary recommendations, meaning kids are essentially playing at all hours without regulated breaks. They concede that federations share advice on screen breaks, diet, sleep, and hydration, but the issue is that it’s all pieced together from various researchers, and no central body collects it.

title: Who Is Aleksib? NAVI IGL Convicted of Aggravated Tax Fraud
content:
Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen has found himself hitting the headlines in and out of the CS2 community recently, but for all the wrong reasons. The NAVI captain, who’s also one of the most prominent in-game leaders in Counter-Strike history, has been convicted of aggravated tax fraud in Finland. The 29-year-old was handed a four-month suspended prison sentence by the Eastern Uusimaa District Court on Tuesday, October 27.

Over the past day, this case has spread like wildfire on social media forums worldwide and garnered the attention of the entire CS2 community because of his status as a Major winner and as one of the game’s most respected IGLs.

For the unaware, Aleksib is a Finnish CS2 pro who rose to fame during his 2019 stint with ENCE, before joining OG and NAVI in the following years. He became the first Finnish player to win a CS2 Major when NAVI claimed the PGL Major Copenhagen title in March 2024. Shortly after, he earned HLTV’s IGL of the Year award, and reports estimate his career tournament earnings at around $975,641 USD across 144 tournaments.

To this day, Aleksib is playing with NAVI as the roster’s primary IGL and recently helped the org secure a first-place finish at the IEM Atlanta 2026.

Aleksib’s case revolves around payments from Valve in 2019, reportedly linked to in-game sticker sales, that were missing from his tax return. According to the ruling, roughly €53,200 went unreported, so he paid about €28,200 less tax than he owed.

Aleksib accepted that the income was left off the return, but said it was never his intention to avoid tax. His defense argued that he assumed everything was settled because tax was already being withheld from his regular salary.

title: Test Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 sur PS5 : un retour aux fondamentaux qui fait du bien
content:
Chaque année, la sortie d’un nouveau Call of Duty suscite son lot d’attentes, de débats et de comparaisons avec les épisodes précédents. La série a beau rester une référence du FPS grand public, elle n’a pas toujours réussi à renouveler sa formule sans perdre une partie de son identité. Entre les déplacements toujours plus spectaculaires, les approches parfois très éloignées du champ de bataille traditionnel et les propositions qui privilégient la surenchère, j’avais parfois eu l’impression que la franchise cherchait davantage à se réinventer qu’à perfectionner ce qu’elle savait déjà faire. Avec Modern Warfare 4, Infinity Ward semble avoir pris une direction différente : revenir à un cadre militaire contemporain, à des affrontements plus lisibles et à une action nerveuse, sans pour autant renoncer aux sensations qui ont fait le succès de la licence.

Dès mes premières parties, j’ai apprécié cette volonté de retrouver un équilibre entre efficacité arcade et crédibilité visuelle. Les soldats restent rapides, les fusillades conservent leur intensité et les affrontements peuvent basculer en quelques secondes, mais les mouvements paraissent un peu plus mesurés. Les armes ont du poids, les déplacements gagnent en cohérence et les différentes possibilités offertes sur le terrain enrichissent les combats sans transformer chaque rencontre en concours de figures acrobatiques. Le résultat n’a rien d’un simulateur militaire pur et dur, et ce n’est d’ailleurs pas ce que je lui demande. Modern Warfare 4 cherche plutôt à proposer un FPS accessible, réactif et spectaculaire, avec une identité militaire suffisamment affirmée pour se distinguer de certaines orientations plus exubérantes de la série.

Cette direction constitue à mes yeux l’une des grandes réussites de cet épisode. Le jeu ne bouleverse pas tout ce que l’on connaît de Call of Duty, mais il retravaille plusieurs éléments importants pour donner davantage de cohérence à l’ensemble. Surtout, il ne repose pas uniquement sur sa campagne pour convaincre : entre le solo, le multijoueur classique et DMZ, j’ai découvert trois expériences qui partagent les mêmes fondations tout en proposant des objectifs et des sensations suffisamment différents. Cette générosité donne à Modern Warfare 4 une vraie valeur sur la durée et explique en grande partie mon enthousiasme.

C’est par sa campagne que Modern Warfare 4 cherche d’abord à marquer les esprits, et je dois reconnaître qu’Infinity Ward a plutôt bien préparé son retour. L’aventure nous entraîne au cœur d’un conflit international impliquant notamment les deux Corées et la Russie, avec des opérations qui nous conduisent dans plusieurs grandes villes et zones de combat. De Séoul à New York, en passant par d’autres environnements urbains particulièrement soignés, le jeu multiplie les changements de décor et les situations pour éviter que l’histoire ne s’enferme dans une succession de fusillades interchangeables.

La campagne adopte surtout une approche narrative intéressante en alternant plusieurs points de vue. D’un côté, nous découvrons le conflit à travers des soldats sud-coréens, parfois encore novices, qui se retrouvent plongés dans une guerre dépassant largement leur expérience. De l’autre, Captain Price suit une trajectoire plus personnelle, guidée par une volonté de vengeance qui l’amène à remettre en question certains principes ayant longtemps défini le personnage. Cette opposition entre des combattants confrontés brutalement à la réalité du terrain et un opérateur chevronné engagé dans une affaire intime donne au récit une dimension plus humaine qu’une simple succession de missions héroïques.

J’ai particulièrement apprécié les séquences qui prennent le temps de montrer les conséquences du conflit sur les populations civiles. Modern Warfare 4 ne se contente pas d’aligner des explosions et des interventions spectaculaires : il cherche aussi à faire ressentir la violence d’une guerre qui ne touche pas uniquement les soldats présents sur le front. Certaines missions, notamment du côté nord-coréen, adoptent un ton plus sombre et mettent en scène des situations difficiles, qui contrastent efficacement avec les opérations plus classiques menées par des unités d’élite. Cette diversité de points de vue permet de renouveler l’approche du récit et donne parfois aux événements une intensité qui dépasse le simple plaisir de l’action.

Un changement qui pourrait redistribuer les cartes, en offrant davantage d’opportunités aux formations issues des circuits secondaires et en renforçant la concurrence pour les places internationales.

Après un début de saison compliqué, la structure brésilienne avait complètement renversé la situation grâce à l’arrivée de nouveaux talents, jusqu’à remporter les Champions 2026 à Shanghai. Devenue la première organisation à décrocher deux titres mondiaux sur VALORANT avec deux effectifs entièrement différents, LOUD pourrait aborder la prochaine saison avec de grandes ambitions.

D’autres formations comme NRG, Paper Rex, Team Liquid ou encore Team Vitality pourraient également jouer les premiers rôles. Pour les structures engagées sur plusieurs jeux, l’Esports World Cup représentera aussi une occasion précieuse de marquer des points au classement général du Club Championship. Avec un circuit VCT profondément remanié et de nouveaux prétendants susceptibles d’émerger, cette édition 2027 s’annonce particulièrement ouverte.

title: How to get Point Blank Kills in Modern Warfare 4
content:
There are some weapon camo challenges throughout Call of Duty history that give players the most trouble. In Modern Warfare 4 , several of these camo challenges have returned, including getting Point Blank Kills. These types of kills have long been a thorn in the side of camo grinders, but there are ways to make getting Point Blanks much easier in multiplayer.

Below, we’ll go through how to get Point Blank Kills and the best ways to go about doing so in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer.

For starters, a Point Blank Kill is earned when you eliminate an enemy that is in extremely close proximity to you. It doesn’t matter when you damage an enemy, but when you see the kill pop up in the killfeed, you need to be within a certain range of the enemy for it to count as a Point Blank.

The exact range for a Point Blank Kill in Modern Warfare 4 is currently unknown, but we do know that it’s much closer than you might expect. In most cases, you need to be within roughly two meters of an enemy when you kill them to earn a Point Blank. This goes for all weapon classes as well, so unlike Longshot Kills , you have to be roughly two meters away even if you’re using something like a light machine gun or sniper rifle.

Now that you understand what a Point Blank Kill is, what’s the most optimal way to go about earning them in multiplayer? Well, it slightly depends on the gun you’re using, as some weapons are naturally stronger at closer ranges.

However, for the most part, you’ll want to use mobility attachments on your loadout so you can get your gun up quicker, which helps out tremendously when killing enemies at close-range. You could also go for an entirely hip-fire build and just shoot from the hip when killing enemies up close. This works best for most weapons, but you can ADS with something like an SMG or assault rifle and have the same results.

The Alberta iGaming Corporation (AiGC) has published a new market report, revealing that about $2.81 billion in wagers were placed during the first 11 weeks of the province’s regulated iGaming market.

According to the report, which covers July 13 to Sept. 30, Alberta’s regulated iGaming market generated approximately $2.81 billion in wagers and about $122.1 million in gross gaming revenue (GGR) .

title: Aleksib Suspended Sentence Explained: What the Tax Fraud Verdict Means for NAVI’s Captain
content:
Aleksib has been given a four-month suspended prison sentence after a Finnish district court convicted the NAVI captain of aggravated tax fraud, Finnish media reported on October 27, 2026. The case covered more than €53,000 of Counter-Strike sticker income from Valve that was left off his 2019 tax return. He will not go to prison unless the suspension is broken.

The sentence matches what the prosecutor asked for and sits at the bottom of the legal range for the offence. Here is what Aleksib was found guilty of, what his defence argued and what the verdict means for his career.

Aleksi “Aleksib” Virolainen, 29, was convicted of aggravated tax fraud over income he received from Valve in the 2019 tax year. According to the charges heard at the Eastern Uusimaa District Court, he did not return his pre-filled 2019 tax return, and the Valve payments were missing from it.

The prosecution said that left more than €53,000 of taxable income undeclared and caused his income tax to be assessed more than €28,000 too low. The offence period in the charge runs from May 19 to September 22, 2020, in Vantaa, the window in which the 2019 return was handled.

The money came from Counter-Strike sticker sales. At Valve’s Majors, players and teams get a share of revenue from in-game stickers sold in their name. In 2019, Aleksib played two Majors with ENCE and reached the grand final of IEM Katowice 2019.

No, not under this verdict. A suspended sentence means the prison term is not served as long as the person meets the conditions the court sets and does not commit a new offence during the probation period. The verdict reports we reviewed did not say how long Aleksib’s probation period is.

title: Valve tells indie developers to beat AI clones with community and steady Steam updates
content:
Valve's Steam Business Team told developers worried about AI-made clone games to stop worrying and to instead put that energy into building a community and shipping regular updates. By doing so, they will build the kind of rapport and goodwill with gamers that cloned games can’t compete with. The advice came at the Steam Indie Connect event on Oct. 27, and it’s especially prevalent for indie studios who currently have to sit back and watch as low-effort releases flood the market.

The event was co-hosted by Valve , the Busan Indie Connect Festival Organizing Committee, and the Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA). Tom Giardino and Marc Wilkinson of the Steam Business Team presented, and Matt from Valve's localization team joined the Q&A.

Brutal reality of making 500K on Steam as a game dev https://t.co/pYEd0Hxd1U

Valve's argument is simple: yes, a single mechanic can be cloned quickly, but the core features that foster a genuine connection with players can’t be copied the same way. Making the genuine version the best version has long been Valve's guiding principle, the team said. If developers renew their efforts here, they can only lose to better games that are also made by humans.

On the use of AI itself, Giardino was adamant that he won’t tell developers what they can and can’t do. It’s entirely up to them. "We don't want to be gatekeepers telling developers which tools they should or shouldn't use," he said. Whether to use AI in development, in Valve's view, is the developer's call.

One developer in the Q&A asked about extortion-style emails threatening to clone a game with AI and release it first. Giardino said it was the first time he'd heard of such cases and expressed his regret.

title: Valve on Steam AI Slop: No AI Filter, and AI Clone Extortion Is a Police Matter

Valve’s position fits in four points. It will not police which development tools studios use, AI included. It sees AI clones as an old problem that AI has sped up. Giardino’s advice to developers worried about copycats was to build a community and keep updating the game. He tied that to Valve’s long-standing approach to piracy: avoid aggressive DRM and make the legitimate version the best version.

title: Worlds 2026 : la Karmine Corp épargnée par le tirage, deux monstres pour KOI et G2 !

Après trois journées riches en surprises, le Swiss Stage entre dans une phase décisive. La Karmine Corp peut notamment s’estimer relativement chanceuse après le tirage au sort de ce quatrième tour. Battus successivement par LYON et Bilibili Gaming, les Français retrouveront CTBC Flying Oyster, formation taïwanaise également en 1-2, ce jeudi 29 octobre à 21h. Le tirage a été nettement moins clément avec Movistar KOI et G2 Esports. Toujours en course pour une qualification directe en quarts de finale avec un bilan de 2-1, les Espagnols devront affronter T1, champion du monde en titre, dès mercredi à 21h. Un défi immense pour la bande à Elyoya, qui reste sur une lourde défaite contre Dplus KIA. De son côté, G2 n’aura pas le droit à l’erreur face à Hanwha Life Esports, champion du MSI 2026 et autre grand favori de la compétition. Les deux équipes, actuellement en 1-2, joueront leur survie dans un BO3 programmé le 30 octobre à minuit, dans la nuit de vendredi.

Dans les autres rencontres du tableau à 2-1, Invictus Gaming affrontera LYON, tandis que Top Esports retrouvera Bilibili Gaming dans un choc 100 % chinois. Les vainqueurs de ces trois BO3 rejoindront Gen.G et Dplus KIA en quarts de finale, alors que les perdants devront disputer un cinquième et dernier tour pour tenter de se qualifier.

Enfin, le tableau des équipes en 1-2 proposera également une confrontation entre Team Liquid et LOS, deux formations qui ont sauvé leur peau lors de la troisième journée. Comme pour la Karmine Corp et G2, la moindre défaite sera synonyme d’élimination. Ce quatrième tour pourrait donc déjà sceller le sort de plusieurs grands noms de la compétition, avant l’ultime journée du Swiss Stage.

title: Team Yandex takes down Team Liquid to claim the top spot in Group A in PARI Universe
content:
Despite suffering their first match loss at PARI Universe, Team Yandex bounced back in Game 3 to overwhelm Team Liquid, securing first place in Group A and a favorable playoff position.

The series became a must-see for many fans, as this is the first time that Ammar “ATF” Al-Assaf will fight against his former teammate from Team Falcons, Stanislav “Malr1ne” Potorak. Malr1ne recently took a post TI 15 break, and upon his return, he joined Team Liquid after the departure of Michał “Nisha” Jankowski from the organization.

The highly anticipated matchup between ATF and Malr1ne at PARI Universe featured plenty of playful banter, with both players tipping each other and exchanging in-game chat messages during teamfights. Their antics were reminiscent of their usual behavior when they played together on Team Falcons, which has drawn mixed reactions from the Dota 2 community.

However, throughout the best-of-three (Bo3) series, Team Yandex appeared to have the upper hand, with the roster delivering the kind of performance that few teams in the world can match. Unlike Team Liquid, who suffered consecutive losses against GamerLegion and OG, Team Yandex looked to be in top form, having remained undefeated in the tournament before this series.

Team Yandex quickly decimated Team Liquid in Game 1, courtesy of Alimzhan “watson” Islambekov’s Kez with 14 kills and 35.6k damage. In Game 2, ATF used his classic Huskar in an attempt to close the series, but Team Liquid successfully neutralized it with a Naix-Earthshaker combo.

Team Yandex decided to give ATF’s Huskar another shot, this time pairing it with a mid-lane Invoker and carry Tiny. Team Liquid’s lineup had limited options for soaking up damage, with carry Lifestealer (Naix) being the only hero capable of taking heavy hits. Unable to withstand Team Yandex’s burst damage, Team Liquid called GG in under 30 minutes.

DENDELE stay alive and G2 are out 🇷🇴 @dendelecs take down @G2CSGO 2-1 in Stream B to get on the board at 1W-2L, while G2 are eliminated at 0W-3L #PGLMasters pic.twitter.com/qbnrJdc3lb

Over the seven maps G2 won 81 rounds and lost 104. On Nuke and Inferno on Monday they did not win a single round after half-time, losing both second halves 6-0.

title: All Apex Legends ranks explained: Iron, Emerald, Grandmaster, and more
content:
Apex Legends is updating its ranked system in Season 32. Read on for esports.gg’s quick guide on all of the new Apex Legends ranks, how the updated system works, and more.

There are nine ranks in total under Apex Legends’ new system. These are Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Emerald, Diamond, Master, and Grandmaster.

The new Apex Legends ranks are Iron, Emerald, and Grandmaster. While Iron replaces Rookie, Emerald sits between Platinum and Diamond. As for the Grandmaster rank, it sits at the very top of the ladder. The Apex Predator rank is gone, so the top 750 Grandmaster players represent the best of the best.

In Apex Legends Season 32, all players who are Diamond rank and above become part of the Pro-Am League. Meanwhile, Iron to Emerald players compete in the Open League.

The Emerald rank being between Platinum and Diamond acts as the transitional stage between these different leagues. The Emerald rank also helps players who are hard-stuck in their chase to Diamond.

Additionally, while the Open League places more importance on kills, the Pro-Am League weighs placement higher than kills.

They got one. BetBoom won the second pistol round and turned their CT side into a wall. NAVI’s attack was barely able to plant the bomb, and their only round of the half came when iM won a clutch with three kills. Every other round went to BetBoom.

content:
La reconstruction de la Karmine Corp sur Rocket League prend forme. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Alexandre « Extra » Paoli devrait conserver son poste d’entraîneur principal pour la saison RLCS 2027. Un choix important pour l’organisation française, contrainte de revoir entièrement ses plans après les départs attendus d’Atow et Vatira vers Gentle Mates. Extra avait lui-même discuté avec cette dernière structure pour suivre ses anciens joueurs, avant de finalement privilégier la continuité avec la KC.

Arrivé à la Karmine Corp après avoir pris sa retraite de joueur en 2025, le Français de 24 ans sort d’une première saison réussie sur le banc. Sous sa direction, la KC a notamment remporté le Major de Paris et atteint le dernier carré des Worlds 2026. Mais son maintien prend une dimension particulière avec l’arrivée attendue d’Evan « M0nkey M00n » Rogez, son ancien coéquipier chez Team BDS. Ensemble, les deux Français avaient remporté les Worlds RLCS 2021-2022, avant de marquer durablement l’histoire de la scène compétitive. Ils pourraient désormais se retrouver dans une configuration inédite, avec Extra dans le rôle d’entraîneur et M0nkey M00n comme leader sur le terrain.

Après avoir envisagé un retrait de Rocket League durant l’intersaison, la Karmine Corp aurait finalement choisi de miser sur un mélange d’expérience et de jeunesse. M0nkey M00n devrait être accompagné d’Attila « bibbaba » Eötvös et de reyyn, deux joueurs de seulement 16 ans, encore peu expérimentés au plus haut niveau. Un pari ambitieux, mais qui permettrait aux deux espoirs d’évoluer aux côtés d’un double champion du monde, sous les ordres d’un entraîneur qui connaît parfaitement son jeu.

Cette nouvelle équipe aurait pour mission de tourner la page d’un effectif historique, également marqué par le départ attendu de juicy vers Geekay Esports. La KC devrait faire ses premiers pas avec ce trio lors du RLCS Kick-Off de Londres en décembre, une compétition à laquelle elle est invitée en tant qu’organisation partenaire. Après une intersaison mouvementée, le club français semble donc avoir trouvé les bases de son nouveau projet, avec des ambitions à reconstruire autour du duo Extra – M0nkey M00n.

title: ENCE Bankruptcy: Why the EZ4ENCE Club Collapsed After 13 Years
content:
Finnish esports organization ENCE is filing for bankruptcy. On October 26, 2026, the board of directors of ENCE eSports Oy confirmed the decision on X, ending a 13-year run that included a Counter-Strike Major final at IEM Katowice 2019 and an IEM Dallas title in 2023. The CS2 roster, ranked 103rd on Valve’s regional standings, is left without an organization.

ENCE posted a farewell message titled “The End of an Era” on its official X account on October 26, 2026. The statement said the board had “made the difficult decision to file for bankruptcy” after 13 years.

Head coach Aleksi “allu” Jalli, who first played for ENCE in 2013, reacted with one word: “Heartbroken.” He said he would share more about himself and the team once things settle.

ENCE has not given an official reason. The public record from 2026 shows an organization that was already shrinking and changing course before the filing.

The results never gave the rebuild breathing room. ENCE has not played an HLTV top-tier (MVP-awarding) event since September 2024, which made it far harder to attract sponsors and invites.

ENCE has not said what will happen to its players. In a Finnish bankruptcy, a court-appointed administrator usually takes over the company’s assets and contracts, so the players are likely to look for new teams in the coming weeks. Treat any move as unconfirmed until the players or a new organization announce it.

ENCE posted the news on X under the heading “The end of an era”. The short statement thanked players, staff, partners and fans, and ended with “GG”. It gave no reason for the decision and did not say what happens to the players and staff still under contract.

End of an era 💔 pic.twitter.com/2927yh5fd3

The decision appears to have come without warning for the team. joeski, who signed a permanent deal with ENCE only a month ago, wrote that the news “came out of the blue” and that it was “very disappointing as we just got stuff rolling as a team”.

title: Steam Down: Players Report Widespread Connection Issues on October 26
content:
According to reports, the popular gaming platform Steam is facing widespread outages as players are reporting difficulties in accessing it. While the core services of the platform remain operational, the connection issue is isolated to logging in when connecting via the desktop application or browser.

Based on data from DownDetector , the initial sign of the outage was logged at 3 PM IST on 26th October, with over 500 users experiencing the same issue within 3 hours. As core functionalities remain unharmed, the true extent of the issue has been hard to pinpoint with limited information at hand.

As users continue to report outages, DownDetector claims “Login” as the most reported issue, followed by “Server Connection” and “Game Launching”. The graphs fail to showcase the exact nature of what Steam users are currently facing, but the increasing number of reports suggests it is continuing to affect more and more gamers. With more than 300 reports recorded in the past hour, it will be hard for the developers to ignore it.

Given that Steam houses millions of users, a few hundred reports in an hour mean that this issue is isolated to a particular region or specific users. Interestingly, SteamDB has reported that Steam Store, Community, Web API, and Connection Managers are functioning as usual, making it harder to point out the exact issue that players are facing.

Assuming that users are having difficulty connecting to the Steam server, the Steam desktop application would allow them to launch games that do not rely on the internet in offline mode. It goes without saying that multiplayer titles like Counter-Strike 2 , Dota , and PUBG will be out of reach until the issue is resolved.

At the time of writing, the number of reports is far too low for Valve to acknowledge the issue or release a statement. Rather, this would get fixed in the backend in no time. Unfortunately, the exact timeline for this to get resolved is not available, but keep an eye on SteamDB or Downdetector if you are facing anything similar.

title: FUT snap Vitality’s ten-series streak 2-1 with eight straight rounds on Anubis
content:
Down 8-4 at the half of the deciding map, FUT won the first eight rounds after the switch and closed Anubis 13-10. xfl0ud finished the series with 57 kills, and FUT are the first team through to the playoffs of PGL Masters Bucharest.

Anubis has been the soft spot in Team Vitality ‘s map pool. Over the past three months it was their weakest map, with four wins from nine, and FUT Esports won it 13-5 against them at the IEM Cologne Major in June, one of only two maps they had taken off Vitality this year. On Monday it was the map that ended a run of ten straight series wins for the world’s top-ranked team.

For a half, nothing pointed that way. Vitality had won Mirage 13-9, and on Anubis they were 8-4 up after their CT side, with FUT burning a timeout after five rounds. Then FUT won the second pistol round, beat Vitality’s force buy after it, and did not drop another round until they led 12-8.

🔥 FUT are through to the playoffs of PGL Masters Bucharest 2026 🇷🇴 A 2-1 win over @TeamVitalityCS in Stream A lifts @futesportsgg to a perfect 3W-0L, while Vitality drop to 2W-1L #PGLMasters pic.twitter.com/OZMoSLLP7Z

The eight-round run was built on variety. FUT’s defenders did not hold the same positions round after round: some players took one kill and fell back, others re-peeked or pushed straight into Vitality’s T side, and Vitality never seemed sure where the next fight would come from. xfl0ud won one round on his own with four kills. Late in the run, Krabeni called a push out through B main and carpets, a move FUT had not shown on that side, and took three kills himself in the round. Vitality used their last timeout straight after.

Vitality’s T side finally won a round at 8-12, and then another. At 10-12 FUT’s coach coolio called a timeout, and FUT closed the map in the next round despite a mezii pre-fire that briefly gave Vitality hope.

title: Razer controllers will power Rocket League student finals at FUSE Esports Festival

title: VCT EMEA : Fnatic va boucler un très gros coup avec valyn !

L’Américain s’apprêterait ainsi à quitter le VCT Americas pour découvrir le championnat EMEA, dans le cadre d’une importante restructuration de l’effectif. Son avenir aurait pourtant pu s’écrire de l’autre côté de l’Atlantique : un accord verbal avait initialement été trouvé avec LYON, mais la non-sélection de la structure mexicaine parmi les équipes partenaires du VCT Americas pour 2027-2028 a finalement changé la donne.

Arrivé chez G2 en 2023 et devenu IGL en 2024, valyn s’est imposé comme l’un des principaux artisans des succès de l’organisation nord-américaine. Sous son leadership, G2 a notamment remporté les trois tournois du VCT Americas en 2025, avant de terminer vice-champion du Masters Bangkok. En 2026, l’équipe a ajouté le Stage 1 Americas à son palmarès et atteint le dernier carré des Champions de Shanghai, où elle a été éliminée par 100 Thieves. Son départ s’inscrit dans une reconstruction plus large chez G2, qui devrait notamment accueillir Sato et kiNgg, ce dernier étant pressenti pour reprendre les responsabilités d’IGL.

Du côté de Fnatic, valyn devrait rejoindre un effectif largement remanié pour la saison 2027. La structure britannique serait également sur le point de recruter deux joueurs de Gentle Mates, Martin « marteen » Pátek et Patrik « Minny » Hušek. Deux arrivées qui témoignent de la volonté de Fnatic de renouveler ses forces après une saison 2026 marquée par plusieurs changements. Dans le sens inverse, Emir « Alfajer » Beder devrait quitter l’organisation après cinq années pour rejoindre Gentle Mates.

Finaliste des Champions 2025 et retenue parmi les huit équipes partenaires du VCT EMEA pour le cycle 2027-2028, Fnatic semble déterminée à retrouver les sommets de la scène internationale. Avec l’expérience et le leadership de valyn, associés à l’arrivée attendue de marteen et minny, l’organisation poserait les bases d’un nouveau projet ambitieux. Reste désormais à connaître la composition définitive de son cinq de départ pour la prochaine saison.

title: Dota 2 Reaches Its Highest Concurrent Player Peak Since 2016
content:
Despite being a 13-year-old game, Valve’s Dota 2 remains one of the most popular multiplayer games in the world to this day, consistently ranking among the top titles on Steam Charts with massive player counts.

In fact, the popularity of Dota 2 might be reaching an all-time high, as the game is nearing a whopping 1.1 million active concurrent player peak for the first time in a decade . As per data from Steam Charts , the MOBA recorded a peak concurrent player count of 1,096,364 players on October 25, 2026 , second only to Counter-Strike 2, which had a peak of just over 1.3 million active players.

The last time Dota 2 reached these kinds of numbers was back in 2016, when the game reached its all-time player peak of 1.29 million . This sudden surge of Dota 2 players ten years later is certainly surprising, but a welcome sight for any avid fans of the title.

If Dota 2 continues to grow at this pace, it’s only a matter of time before the title surpasses its all-time peak and sets a new milestone for itself.

Dota 2 reached 1,082,982 concurrent players for the first time since 2016. I guess the game isn't that dead after all… pic.twitter.com/2qEMXrfwUr

The exact reason behind the sudden influx of Dota 2 players is still unclear, with some players claiming that bots are taking up a good chunk of the player count. However, it’s also worth mentioning that over the past few months, Valve has given players plenty of reasons to return and for newbies to give Dota 2 a try by providing a steady stream of updates to the game.

title: Derke and d4v41 top a Valorant transfer market that grows by the day

The player who helped shape Vitality's legacy You brought us our first VCT trophy, took us to our first Champions Grand Finals, and never stopped fighting for more. Thank you Derke 💛 we will always remember your time as a bee. pic.twitter.com/v7byAiD1Oa

The trophy was VCT 2025 EMEA Kickoff, won 3-2 against Team Liquid in February 2025, less than four months after Derke arrived from FNATIC. The grand final came on October 18 in Shanghai, where LOUD beat Vitality 3-1. Without him, Vitality’s roster lists four players: Jamppi, PROFEK, Chronicle and Sayonara. The club is one of the eight EMEA organisations that keep a partner seat for 2027 .

Derke’s two seasons in yellow went in opposite directions. The 2025 lineup, with Less and Sayf alongside him, finished fourth at Masters Bangkok and then slid down the EMEA table, going out in the top eight of both regional stages and missing Champions altogether.

title: Canna voit grand pour les équipes LEC : « On peut même atteindre la finale »
content:
Après son exploit contre Anyone’s Legend, la Karmine Corp a connu un premier coup d’arrêt face à LYON lors du deuxième tour du Swiss Stage. Une défaite frustrante pour les Français, qui avaient pourtant réussi à prendre l’avantage avant de céder dans les combats décisifs. Interrogé par Sheep Esports après la rencontre, Kim « Canna » Chang-dong est revenu sur les difficultés rencontrées par son équipe. « Je pense que les dragons ont été le facteur le plus important de cette partie. Nous avons bien réagi lors du premier combat autour du troisième dragon, mais nous avons été déçus par la façon dont le combat suivant s’est déroulé. Cela nous a mis dans une position beaucoup plus difficile. » Le Coréen estime toutefois que la différence entre les deux formations s’est surtout jouée sur des détails, sans constater d’écart majeur de niveau entre LYON et Anyone’s Legend, pourtant champion de Chine en titre.

Mais au-delà de cette défaite, Canna se montre particulièrement optimiste concernant les chances européennes dans ce Mondial. Alors que KOI a débuté le Swiss Stage avec deux victoires et que G2 tente de retrouver son meilleur niveau, le joueur de la KC estime que les représentants du LEC peuvent viser très haut. « Je pense qu’il y a beaucoup de très bonnes équipes cette année. Atteindre les demi-finales, voire aller encore plus loin, est une possibilité réaliste. Et si elles jouent à leur meilleur niveau, je pense qu’elles pourraient même atteindre la finale. » Une déclaration ambitieuse de la part d’un joueur qui connaît parfaitement le niveau des meilleures formations coréennes, après ses passages chez T1 et Dplus KIA.

Cette confiance tranche avec les premières impressions de Canna lors de son arrivée en Europe. Le toplaner reconnaît avoir initialement sous-estimé le niveau de la région, avant de revoir progressivement son jugement. « Quand je suis arrivé en Europe, je ne trouvais pas le niveau général particulièrement élevé. Mais depuis que je suis ici, j’ai le sentiment que le championnat n’a cessé de progresser. » Il souligne également que plusieurs équipes absentes des Worlds possèdent, selon lui, le potentiel pour briller sur la scène internationale, preuve de la progression globale du LEC.

Un constat encourageant pour les supporters européens, même si la route reste longue avant d’envisager une place dans le dernier carré. La Karmine Corp devra d’abord rebondir face à Bilibili Gaming ce lundi, dans une rencontre importante pour la suite de son Swiss Stage. Après avoir déjà fait tomber le premier seed chinois, Canna et ses coéquipiers auront une nouvelle occasion de démontrer que les ambitions européennes ne se limitent pas aux déclarations.

title: Does Shirrako Have GTA 6 Early? What We Know About the Rumoured Rockstar NDA Breach

title: GTA 6 Will Have Hundreds of Explorable Interiors, Rockstar Confirms
content:
GTA 6 will have hundreds of interiors that players can walk into and explore, according to Rockstar. The figure came out of a studio demo at Rockstar North that Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier attended, where the developers said there are “hundreds” of these little spaces to find. It is one of the clearest upgrades over GTA 5, where most of Los Santos sat behind closed doors.

Rockstar has not given an exact number. Here is what the studio has said, what the demo showed and how the interiors tie into robberies.

“Hundreds” is as precise as Rockstar has been. During the Bloomberg demo, a Rockstar developer described “so many of these little interiors” that players can explore, putting the count in the hundreds. Any specific figure you see online beyond that, including lists claiming 700 or more enterable buildings, is fan speculation and not something Rockstar has confirmed.

The studio also stressed how those rooms were built. In an August interview with The New York Times, Rockstar North’s Aaron Garbut said that someone thought about every room in the game, down to who is sitting where and the marks left on a table. That points to interiors designed one by one, as opposed to copied from a template.

GTA 5 had plenty of buildings, but most were facades. You could enter a handful of shops, safehouses, mission locations and a few set pieces, and the rest of the city stayed shut. Rockstar has never published an official count for GTA 5, so we are not putting a number on it, but anyone who played it knows how often a door led nowhere.

The map is the less dramatic part of the jump. Reports from the previews suggest Leonida is not hugely larger than Los Santos and Blaine County, and most of the extra work went into density: narrower roads, more buildings and more of them open to the player. title: Call of Duty: Black Ops II Is Among the Best-Selling Games of 2026, 14 Years After Launch
content:
Call of Duty: Black Ops II, a game that first launched in November 2012, is the sixth best-selling game of 2026 in the US so far. Circana’s year-to-date chart through September puts it ahead of Forza Horizon 6, Tomodachi Life and Pokemon Pokopia, almost entirely on the back of the PS4 and PS5 port that Activision released on July 9. Those new PlayStation versions sent a 14-year-old shooter to the top of the US monthly chart in July.

Here is where it sits, how it got there so fast and why it matters for Call of Duty.

These are Circana’s projected US best-sellers for January to September 2026, ranked by dollar sales across physical and full-game digital purchases. Mobile games and add-on content are not counted.

Marvel’s Wolverine, which topped September after launching mid-month, sits 11th for the year. We covered that launch and the PS5 hardware bump in our September Circana breakdown .

Because PlayStation owners could not buy it before July. Black Ops II originally came out on PS3, Xbox 360, PC and Wii U, and the PS3 version never ran on PS4 or PS5. Xbox players kept access through backward compatibility, and PC players through Steam. Anyone on a modern PlayStation was locked out for over a decade.

Activision fixed that on July 9 with surprise PS4 and PS5 releases of both Black Ops and Black Ops II. Treyarch and Iron Galaxy handled the ports. Each game includes the campaign, multiplayer and Zombies, while the original map packs are sold separately through a season pass. Launch pricing was $19.99 per game until August 6, after which the standard price became $39.99.

title: RLCS : ExoTiiK va rebondir avec yujin et Rezears
content:

Les trois joueurs, actuellement libres de tout contrat, disputeront les qualifications ouvertes du RLCS Kick-Off Open avec l’ambition de décrocher l’unique place disponible pour le London Kick-Off Weekend. Le Français Thomas « Ekon » Chenel, ancien sélectionneur de l’équipe de France lors des FIFAe Continental Championships, accompagnera le trio en tant qu’entraîneur. Dans son annonce, ExoTiiK a également précisé que l’effectif était toujours à la recherche d’une organisation pour la saison prochaine.

Ce nouveau projet marque un rebond rapide pour ExoTiiK, dont le départ de Vitality a été officialisé le 20 octobre. Après deux saisons chez les Abeilles, le champion du monde 2024 avait notamment atteint la finale du Major de Boston aux côtés de zen et stizzy, avant de participer aux Worlds 2026. Son départ intervient alors que Vitality prépare une reconstruction autour de nass, Oski et diaz, un trio qui aurait déjà trouvé un accord verbal avec l’organisation française.

Ses deux nouveaux coéquipiers ont également des raisons de vouloir se relancer. Âgé de 18 ans, yujin avait été envisagé par la Karmine Corp durant ce mercato, avant que le club ne privilégie finalement bibbaba pour accompagner M0nkey M00n et reyyn. title: Fortnite Wins Australian Court Battle, Reclaims Spot on iOS
content:
Fortnite returns to iOS in Australia on October 22, 2026, after the Federal Court of Australia ruled against Apple in the Epic Games antitrust case. Justice Jonathan Beach found that Apple broke competition law by limiting app distribution and payment options. Epic announced the return on X, and Apple plans to appeal. It also ordered Apple to readmit Fortnite and other Epic apps once Epic sends a written request. Readmission stays subject to App Store rules that match the court’s orders.

title: How to find and open a Safe in Modern Warfare 4 DMZ
content:
Throughout your career in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ, you’ll continually get to complete DMZ Orders, which are specific tasks that earn you rewards the more you complete them. While some of the DMZ Orders are simple, others can be rather difficult, and one of the more challenging ones is to “Open a Safe.”

While this sounds trivial at first glance, you then realize that Safes aren’t too common to find on the Hajin map in DMZ. Luckily, though, we know of some dedicated spots for Safes that allow you to complete this DMZ Order with no problem at all.

For us, this specific DMZ Order was on Page 5, and it even says that you can find Safes in Compounds and Locked Spaces . Of course, that doesn’t help a lot, as you still need to go out and search for these locations and then locate the Safe itself.

While you might have some serious trouble trying to find a “Locked Space,” you shouldn’t have many problems locating a Compound. These are marked by a tent icon on your Tac-Map and are fairly common in Hajin, particularly out in the woodlands or the side roads in between the major points of interest on the map.

In order to open a Safe in a Compound, you need to enter it and then clear out 100% of the enemy AI from the area . This is tracked by a percentage meter that appears on the left side of your screen when you enter a Compound. There are usually around 10-12 enemies in each Compound, and when they’re all cleared out, your meter will read 100%.

From here, you need to find the Safe that the Compound has stashed. For the most part, the Safe is located at the top of the guard tower, which is found at most Compounds . Just climb the stairs to get to the top, and you’ll find the Safe sitting on the ground next to a desk. Interact with it, loot the contents, and you’ll get a mission completion for this DMZ Order.

title: How to get the Tactical Nuke killstreak in Modern Warfare 4
content:
The most iconic killstreak in the entire Call of Duty franchise is the Tactical Nuke, and it’s confirmed to be returning in Modern Warfare 4 . Not only was the Nuke seen in a recent MW4 trailer, but we’ve also seen gameplay of the streak in a real match.

So, naturally, this has caused players everywhere to wonder: how do you get the Nuke in Modern Warfare 4? We’ll break the killstreak down for you in the guide below.

It’s been fully confirmed that the Tactical Nuke is an earnable killstreak in Modern Warfare 4. We’ve already seen players earn the Nuke, and you call it in very similarly to other games in the Modern Warfare franchise.

The Tactical Nuke is earned when you go on a 30 killstreak in MW4. Only gun, equipment, and Field Upgrade kills count towards this streak, so you can’t factor in kills from other killstreaks. When you go on a 30 streak, you’ll get a notification that you can call in the Nuke, which immediately ends the current match and wins the game for your team . You’ll then see a unique animation play out, including your character throwing up their middle finger while being blown away by the Nuke explosion.

Just like in every other Modern Warfare game, the Tactical Nuke isn’t a killstreak that you equip as part of your three core streaks . It’s a streak that’s active for all players at all times, so whenever you go on a 30 killstreak, you’ll earn the ability to call in the Nuke.

So there you have it: the Tactical Nuke is a killstreak in Modern Warfare 4, and it’s only earned once you hit a 30 killstreak with your gun or equipment. You can’t cheese the Nuke using killstreak kills like you could in the original MW2, so it’s very rare that you’ll earn or see a Nuke called in during a match of MW4.

title: All Weapon Prestige Camos in Modern Warfare 4 & how to earn them
content:
There are several different forms of progression in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , and one of the newer grinds in multiplayer is earning Weapon Prestige Camos. This system was brought back to the franchise in Black Ops 7, and Modern Warfare 4 has kept it in multiplayer, but with some twists.

Weapon Prestige Camos can be earned across all 33 weapons in MW4, but there are only four of them in total to unlock. You unlock each camo the same way for all weapons, but, of course, you need to know the unlock method before you start the grind. Below, we’ll explain everything you need to know about earning Weapon Prestige Camos in MW4.

The four Weapon Prestige Camos in MW4 multiplayer are: Pyroclast, Pyroclast Terminus, Pyroclast Scatter, and Pyroclast Cascade. You won’t start the process of earning any of these camos until you reach Weapon Prestige 1 with a weapon. This is accomplished by getting to that weapon’s max level, which usually goes to around 65-70 for most primary weapons.

Once you reach the max level for a weapon, you can enter Weapon Prestige , which works the same way that Classic Prestige Mode works in MW4 . When you enter Weapon Prestige, you reset that weapon back to level one and re-lock any non-shared attachments for it. You keep all shared attachments, though. From this point, you can re-unlock all weapon levels, and when you reach max level again, you’ll start earning Weapon Prestige Master levels. There are then 250 total levels to max out Weapon Prestige Master .

You can only Prestige weapons a single time in MW4, but once you do, you can start unlocking Weapon Prestige Camos. Look below to find out what you need to do to unlock all four Weapon Prestige Camos in multiplayer:

Unlike in Black Ops 7, which has unique Weapon Prestige Camos for every single weapon, the four camos are the same for all weapons in Modern Warfare 4. So, just because you earn Pyroclast Cascade for the M4 doesn’t then mean you have it unlocked for the Patriot XMR. Every Weapon Prestige grind is separate, but the Weapon Prestige Camos are the same.

title: Best Permanent Unlocks to spend Tokens on in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Classic Prestige has returned in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, and that means that Permanent Unlock Tokens are coming back as well. If you’re unfamiliar with how Prestige Mode works, it resets your level back to one, but you receive a Permanent Unlock Token that you can use on any class item in multiplayer in exchange.

This is a huge benefit, as it lets you permanently unlock an item so you never have to unlock it again during the entire Prestige grind in Modern Warfare 4 . However, with so many items to choose from, which unlock gives you the best bang for your buck?

Below, we’ll give you five distinct class items in MW4 multiplayer that are most worth spending a Permanent Unlock Token on after you Prestige. The item list is in order from 1-5.

First on the list has to be the Stim, which is a piece of Tactical Equipment that quickly heals you back to full health when applied. The Stim is unlocked at level 47 in MW4 multiplayer, making it one of the final items you’ll unlock every single Prestige.

While there are other solid pieces of Tactical Equipment you can use until that level, once you get used to the Stim, there’s really no going back. The ability to get back into the fight instantly after being injured, compared to waiting for several seconds to recoup health, is one of the most important benefits of any item in multiplayer. If you use a Permanent Unlock Token on the Stim, your Tactical slot is pretty much set in stone on all loadouts in multiplayer.

Next up, we have the Axion assault rifle, which is unlocked at level 52. The Axion is one of the best assault rifles in Modern Warfare 4, and having it available for only three levels every Prestige is ultimately a waste of its potential. This is arguably a top meta weapon in multiplayer, so you’ll want it permanently unlocked as soon as possible.

title: How to level up weapons faster in Modern Warfare 4
content:
Weapon leveling is one of the core elements in any Call of Duty, but the 33 total weapons in Modern Warfare 4 have dozens of levels that you need to grind through. While it will take a long time before you reach max level with all weapons, or even your favorites, there are some key tips you can take advantage of to make the leveling process much less stressful. To see the best ways to level up your weapons quickly in Modern Warfare 4, keep reading the guide below.

We’ll lay out some distinct, fast weapon leveling methods for Modern Warfare 4, but they will mostly be tied to multiplayer.

It’s one of the most common ways to earn more XP in Call of Duty, but that’s because it simply works the best. While you can certainly get more overall XP by playing objective game modes, this also applies to weapon XP.

The more XP you earn during the course of a match, the more XP is applied to the weapon that you’re currently using. So, while kills still offer the most weapon XP possible, playing the objective and earning match score that way also grants you weapon XP.

The best objective modes to play if you want to earn weapon XP faster than any other method are Kill Confirmed, Hardpoint, and Domination , but the first two are going to be your best bets. When playing Kill Confirmed, make sure you’re picking up any dog tag possible for the max amount of XP, while in Hardpoint you want to continually attack the hill, getting kills in and around it for extra XP.

As long as you’re primarily using the weapon you want to level up fast in Modern Warfare 4, you’ll get a ton of regular and weapon XP in objective game modes.

Le recrutement de solar constitue une véritable surprise. Repéré grâce à son ascension fulgurante dans les classements en ligne, l’Américain n’a encore jamais disputé de Main Event RLCS. Il a néanmoins montré des qualités prometteuses en terminant dans le Top 12 du Last Chance Qualifier nord-américain aux côtés de Druee et Kehvn. Il a également atteint la phase suisse des Opens 1v1 et 2v2 de sa région, avec deux Top 22 à la clé. Initialement attendu chez 9Lives avec monk et Juice, il a finalement choisi de rejoindre Spacestation Gaming.

Ce choix s’inscrit dans la tradition de Spacestation Gaming, réputée pour avoir révélé plusieurs jeunes talents nord-américains, notamment Daniel, Sypical et Arsenal. Mais solar devra rapidement faire ses preuves au sein d’une équipe qui sort d’une saison 2026 exceptionnelle. Après un Top 8 au Major de Paris, SSG a enchaîné deux finales internationales, à l’Esports World Cup puis aux championnats du monde RLCS, s’inclinant à chaque fois face à Team Falcons.

Avec reveal et zach comme coéquipiers, solar aura donc la lourde tâche de succéder à diaz et de maintenir Spacestation Gaming parmi les meilleures formations mondiales. Un immense défi pour un joueur de 17 ans qui s’apprête à découvrir le plus haut niveau, avec le Club Championship 2027 en ligne de mire.
